main.description: An append-only change to agreed terms — the plan is meant to change, but never silently. You never overwrite the agreement; you supersede it. Applies only to an already-accepted agreement. Proposes a delta and takes effect only when EVERY current principal co-signs it with org.buildguild.acceptance (the proposer by authoring; a member being added must accept; on removal the remaining members + patron suffice) — as mutual as the original deal. Either side may propose any field; full consent is the guard. Current terms = the original offer folded with the ordered chain of accepted amendments; the diff between any two links is the paper trail. Unaccepted amendments stay visible as proposed-but-not-agreed. Author's `role` says which side proposed. Written to the proposer's repo.

supersedes.description: The org.buildguild.offer or prior org.buildguild.amendment this changes (the chain link it builds on).

changes.description: The fields being changed; omitted fields are unchanged from the superseded state.

amount.description: New reward total in minor units.

reason.description: Why the change — part of the public trail.
